title: Every part line sits in the row of what priced it
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test at your location, in category A, cost $10.00, fixed sell price $12.50.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $121.50 by tier A; the fixed-price part at $12.50; a special-order part in category A, cost $50.00, with a typed price of $80.00; and line 2 with a fixed line total of $450.00 ($240.00 labor) holding one part in category A, quantity 1, cost $30.00, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick customer A in the Customer filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens on this month.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's row (its number and name, for example "7 · Fleet Test") reads Parts Cost $100.00, Parts Invoiced $121.50.
  • Fixed price reads Parts Cost $10.00, Parts Invoiced $12.50.
  • Fixed line total reads Parts Cost $30.00, Parts Invoiced $210.00 ($450.00 − $240.00 = $210.00).
  • Manual reads Parts Cost $50.00, Parts Invoiced $80.00.
  • Totals read Parts Cost $190.00 ($100.00 + $10.00 + $30.00 + $50.00) and Parts Invoiced $424.00 ($121.50 + $12.50 + $210.00 + $80.00).
  • No Default row and no Before tiers row show for customer A.

AUTOMATION: Not available on Build to test Yet - Last checked 11/14/2026
